name: When should I consider replacing my bathroom drywall?
description: Replace bathroom drywall if you see water damage (swelling, discoloration), mold, or significant physical damage.

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my bathroom drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing your bathroom drywall if you notice signs of water damage, such as swelling, discoloration, soft spots, or a musty odor. Visible mold growth, even after cleaning, also indicates a need for replacement. Additionally, if the drywall is significantly damaged due to impacts or structural issues, replacement is often more effective than repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace bathroom drywall if you see water damage (swelling, discoloration), mold, or significant physical damage.
